GLP-1 receptor agonists (e.g., semaglutide, liraglutide) are explicitly recommended for **weight management in patients with type 2 diabetes and obesity**, in addition to lifestyle interventions, due to their combined glycemic and weight-beneficial effects [ADA, 2024]. This guidance is part of the American Diabetes Association’s Standards of Care for obesity management in T2D. 

For context, the ADA also emphasizes metformin as the preferred initial pharmacologic agent for T2D, but GLP-1 drugs are specifically highlighted for patients needing weight loss support [ADA, 2024]. Clinical use should consider individual patient factors, contraindications, and integration with lifestyle modifications. 

Always consult a healthcare provider for personalized evaluation and management.
